# GFxtra

> > GFxtra is a comprehensive resource hub for digital creatives, offering premium design assets, stock photos, 3D models, video templates, and curated tutorials from leading platforms like CreativeLive, Udemy, and Learn Squared.

The site aggregates high-quality creative resources including mockups from MRMockup, photography courses from Finding North Photography and Photigy, 3D assets from Chaos Cosmos Library, and technical tutorials covering Houdini, motion graphics, and design workflows. Content is organized with guest access restrictions for premium downloads.

## Key Topics

- Design Resources
- 3D Models & Renders
- Stock Photos & Digital Assets
- Tutorial Collections
- CreativeLive Courses
- Photography Courses
- Mockups & Templates
- Houdini
- Motion Graphics
- Video Templates
- Creative Assets
- Technical Abstracts
- Premium Downloads
- Guest Access Restricted Content

## Design Resources & Assets

- [Synthwave Design Resources](https://www.gfxtra31.com/2020/05/24/synthwave.html): Synthwave design resources with tutorials from CreativeLive & mockups

- [Aphrodite & Venus Statues & Illustrations](https://www.gfxtra31.com/only-for-you/special-png/2483284-aphrodite-venus-statues-illustrations-10xpng-17xai.html): AdobeStock Aphrodite & Venus statue vectors & PNGs (27 files)
